Order No.03 Dated 19th May, 2023 Heard, Ms. Satya Shatakshi learned counsel for the applicant and Mr. Subodh Kumar Dubey, learned A.P.P for the State.
2.

This second bail application has been filed on behalf of the abovenamed applicant with prayer to release on bail in connection with Misc. Criminal Application No.242 of 2023, arising out of Special (POCSO) Case No.62 of 2021 (Sonua P.S. Case No.45 of 2021), registered under Sections 376 (2) (n)
of the Indian Penal Code and Sections 4/6 of the POCSO Act, pending in the Court of learned Special Judge (POCSO) Act, West Singhbhum at Chaibasa.

sentences.text: 3. Learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that earlier the prayer for bail of the applicant was rejected by this Court vide order dated 15.06.2022 passed in B.A No.5085 of 2022.

By way of present bail application, the applicant has renewed his prayer for bail, primarily for the reasons that after rejection of the first bail application, the victim was examined before the learned Trial Court and she has not supported the prosecution case.

It is further submitted that the applicant has been languishing in jail since 11.11.2021 and at least considering the length of judicial custody, the applicant may be given to privilege of regular bail.

4. Learned A.P.P appearing on behalf of the State vehemently opposed the contentions made by the learned counsel for the applicant.

5. After rejection of the first bail application of the applicant, if the trial has commenced and the victim girl has not supported the prosecution story, her testimony cannot be evaluated at the time of disposal of the 2nd bail application.
6. In view of the submission made and materials on record, the plea raised by the learned counsel for the applicant cannot be accepted as a new ground for second bail application.
Accordingly, the second bail application of the applicant is hereby rejected.
7. However, learned Trial Court is directed to expedite the trial, as prayed for by the learned counsel for the applicant.

(Subhash Chand, J.) Raja/-
